name: General Continuum Mechanics
description: Field and particle theories in physics. Historical development of continuum mechanics. Stress and strain. Elasticity, viscoelasticity and elastoplasticity; Newtonian fluids. Continuum thermomechanics; Classius-Duhem inequality; thermodynamics with internal variables. Constitutive equations; frame indifference; non- Newtonian fluids. Materials of differential/gradient type; configurational mechanics; biomechanics; nanomechanics. Theories of conduction and diffusion; multi-physics problems: thermoelasticity and electromagnetoelasticity; chemomechanics, current trends.
